subject.title: fix(auth-health): prefer usable OAuth over expired inventory in provider status

question: Should a healthy OAuth profile ever mask a `missing` OAuth profile at provider level, or should this PR only mask stale `expired` inventory?
rationale: The current patch changes the operator-visible auth warning contract beyond the reported stale-expired case, so maintainer intent is needed if missing profiles are meant to become non-blocking inventory rather than warnings.

options.title: Keep Missing Visible
options.body: Move the healthy override behind `missing` in both rollups, add mixed `ok` plus `missing` regression coverage, and keep this PR scoped to stale expired inventory.

options.title: Accept Missing Masking
options.body: Maintain the current precedence but document and test that a healthy OAuth profile intentionally suppresses missing-profile provider warnings.

options.title: Pause For Canonical Scope
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide whether the stale badge requires this rollup change, the cache-refresh PR, or both together.

recommendation.title: Keep Missing Visible
recommendation.body: Move the healthy override behind `missing` in both rollups, add mixed `ok` plus `missing` regression coverage, and keep this PR scoped to stale expired inventory.
